category.name: Academic English
category.description: Menulis dan membaca teks ilmiah: argumentasi, metode, dan analisis.

words.definition: An idea suggested as an explanation, to be tested.
words.example: The data supports our hypothesis.

words.definition: To examine something in detail to understand it.
words.example: Researchers analyse the results carefully.
words.example_id: Para peneliti menganalisis hasilnya dengan cermat.

words.definition: To mention a source as evidence in academic writing.
words.example: You must cite every source you use.
words.example_id: Kamu wajib mengutip setiap sumber yang dipakai.

words.definition: Logical and well organised, easy to follow.
words.example: Her essay presents a coherent argument.

words.definition: Based on observation or experience rather than theory.
words.example: The claim needs empirical evidence.

words.definition: The set of methods used in a study.
words.example: The paper explains its methodology in detail.
words.example_id: Makalah itu menjelaskan metodologinya secara rinci.

words.definition: Large or important enough to have an effect.
words.example: There was a significant improvement in scores.
words.example_id: Ada peningkatan yang signifikan pada skor.

words.definition: A fact or event that can be observed.
words.example: Social media is a global phenomenon.

words.definition: To judge the value or quality of something.
words.example: We evaluate each method before choosing one.
words.example_id: Kami mengevaluasi setiap metode sebelum memilih.

words.definition: A basic structure used to organise ideas or systems.
words.example: The study uses a simple theoretical framework.
words.example_id: Penelitian itu memakai kerangka teoretis sederhana.

words.definition: A short summary at the start of an academic paper.
words.example: The abstract summarises the whole study.

words.definition: A set of reasons supporting an idea.
words.example: Her argument is supported by three studies.

words.definition: Facts that show something is true.
words.example: There is little evidence for that claim.
words.example_id: Hanya sedikit bukti untuk klaim itu.

words.definition: The books and articles written about a subject.
words.example: The literature on this topic is extensive.
words.example_id: Literatur tentang topik ini sangat luas.

words.definition: Something that can change in an experiment.
words.example: Age was the strongest variable in the model.
words.example_id: Usia adalah variabel terkuat dalam model itu.

words.definition: A connection between two things that change together.
words.example: There is a strong correlation between the two scores.
words.example_id: Ada korelasi kuat antara kedua skor itu.

words.definition: Based on descriptions rather than numbers.
words.example: She chose a qualitative approach.

words.definition: Based on numbers and measurements.
words.example: The survey produced quantitative data.

words.definition: A judgement reached after considering the evidence.
words.example: The conclusion restates the main findings.

words.definition: A possible effect or result of something.
words.example: The study has implications for teachers.

words.definition: A typical model or way of thinking about something.
words.example: The discovery created a new paradigm.

words.definition: The quality of being based on truth or sound reasoning.
words.example: Reviewers questioned the validity of the method.

words.definition: An unfair preference that affects judgement.
words.example: The sample may contain bias.

words.definition: A source mentioned in a text.
words.example: Add a reference for every quotation.

words.definition: To collect information and arrange it.
words.example: They compiled data from ten schools.
words.example_id: Mereka menyusun data dari sepuluh sekolah.

words.definition: To obtain something from a source.
words.example: The formula is derived from earlier work.
words.example_id: Rumus itu diturunkan dari penelitian sebelumnya.

words.definition: To show that something is likely true.
words.example: The results indicate a clear trend.

words.definition: To judge the quality or importance of something.
words.example: Two teachers assessed each essay.

words.definition: To explain the meaning of information.
words.example: Readers may interpret the graph differently.
words.example_id: Pembaca dapat menafsirkan grafik itu secara berbeda.

words.definition: To provide evidence that supports a claim.
words.example: The author failed to substantiate the claim.

words.definition: A set of questions used to collect opinions.
words.example: We sent the survey to 200 students.

words.definition: A small part chosen to represent the whole.
words.example: The sample included both age groups.

words.definition: Numbers that describe a group of data.
words.example: The statistics show steady growth.

words.definition: A person of the same age or status.
words.example: The article was reviewed by two peers.
words.example_id: Artikel itu ditinjau oleh dua rekan sejawat.

words.definition: A magazine that publishes academic research.
words.example: Her paper appeared in a language journal.

words.definition: A reference to a source used in writing.
words.example: Every citation must be complete.

words.definition: Using someone else's work as your own.
words.example: Plagiarism is treated very seriously.

words.definition: To repeat a study to check the results.
words.example: Other teams could not replicate the finding.
words.example_id: Tim lain tidak dapat mereplikasi temuan itu.

words.definition: A standard used to judge something.
words.example: Clarity is the main criterion.

words.definition: Something you accept as true without proof.
words.example: The model rests on one assumption.
words.example_id: Model itu berdasar pada satu asumsi.

words.definition: An abstract idea or general notion.
words.example: The concept is easy to explain.

words.definition: The situation around something that gives it meaning.
words.example: Read the sentence in context.

words.definition: A careful judgement of a work or idea.
words.example: She wrote a critique of the article.
words.example_id: Dia menulis kritik atas artikel itu.

words.definition: To state the exact meaning of something.
words.example: Define the term before you use it.

words.definition: To show clearly with evidence or examples.
words.example: The study demonstrates a clear effect.
words.example_id: Penelitian itu menunjukkan efek yang jelas.

words.definition: The way something is spread or shared.
words.example: The distribution of scores is uneven.

words.definition: Moral principles that guide behaviour.
words.example: Research ethics must be respected.

words.definition: To produce or create something.
words.example: The survey generated useful data.

words.definition: To give a good reason for something.
words.example: Can you justify that conclusion?

words.definition: To combine ideas into a whole.
words.example: The review synthesizes twenty studies.
words.example_id: Ulasan itu menyintesis dua puluh penelitian.

words.definition: Based on ideas rather than practice.
words.example: The paper is mostly theoretical.

words.definition: A list of sources used in a text.
words.example: Check the bibliography for primary sources.
words.example_id: Periksa daftar pustaka untuk sumber utama.

words.definition: The relationship between cause and effect.
words.example: Correlation does not prove causality.

words.definition: Belonging to the present time.
words.example: The study focuses on contemporary issues.
words.example_id: Penelitian itu fokus pada isu kontemporer.

words.definition: Public disagreement about something.
words.example: The finding caused controversy.

words.definition: A formal discussion of opposing ideas.
words.example: The debate lasted two hours.

words.definition: Language used in a particular field.
words.example: Academic discourse has its own style.

words.definition: A short part taken from a longer text.
words.example: Read the excerpt on page four.

words.definition: A note at the bottom of a page.
words.example: The source is given in a footnote.

words.definition: The great size or importance of something.
words.example: The magnitude of the effect surprised us.

words.definition: An idea or belief about something.
words.example: The notion is widely accepted.

words.definition: Seeming reasonable or probably true.
words.example: She offered a plausible explanation.
words.example_id: Dia memberi penjelasan yang masuk akal.

words.definition: To improve something by small changes.
words.example: They refined the model twice.

words.definition: Correct and exact.
words.example: The data must be accurate.

words.definition: To change to suit new conditions.
words.example: The method adapts to small samples.
words.example_id: Metode itu menyesuaikan untuk sampel kecil.

words.definition: Next to or near something.
words.example: The library is adjacent to the lab.

words.definition: To publicly support an idea.
words.example: She advocates open data.

words.definition: A total formed from many parts.
words.example: The aggregate score was high.

words.definition: Although (formal).
words.example: The result is useful, albeit limited.

words.definition: To give resources for a purpose.
words.example: They allocated more time for questions.
words.example_id: Mereka mengalokasikan lebih banyak waktu untuk tanya jawab.

words.definition: Having more than one possible meaning.
words.example: Avoid ambiguous wording.

words.definition: To change a text or law slightly.
words.example: The author amended chapter three.

words.definition: A comparison that explains an idea.
words.example: He used an analogy with water flow.

words.definition: Extra material at the end of a book.
words.example: The tables are in the appendix.

words.definition: Based on chance rather than reason.
words.example: The cut-off point seemed arbitrary.

words.definition: One part of a situation or idea.
words.example: The study examines three aspects.

words.definition: To decide after considering evidence.
words.example: The authors conclude that more data is needed.

words.definition: To show differences between things.
words.example: The contrast between groups was clear.

words.definition: A collection of related data.
words.example: The dataset covers ten years.
words.example_id: Kumpulan data itu mencakup sepuluh tahun.

words.definition: A drawing that explains something.
words.example: Figure one shows a simple diagram.

words.definition: A first version of a text.
words.example: Send me the first draft.

words.definition: To show a quality or behaviour.
words.example: The sample exhibits high variance.

words.definition: A mathematical rule expressed in symbols.
words.example: Apply the formula to each row.
